title: BT-DHT, SDP, RTSP: Use tvb_get_string_uint to eliminate string copies
description:
Note that if the string is being added to the tree, it's probably faster
to call tvb_get_string_uint in a separate line than add_item_ret_string,
because it eliminates string copying in the case where the item is
faked.

AI-Assisted: no
